create_BoxList: create a BoxList from a numpy array of bounding box coordinates in [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max] format
build_BoxList_with_fields: build a BoxList and add extra fields like classification scores or objectness labels
test_BoxList_num_boxes: test the BoxList num_boxes method to verify the count of bounding boxes
review_BoxList_get_coordinates: review the BoxList get_coordinates method that returns separate y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max arrays
summarize_BoxList_add_field: summarize the BoxList add_field method for attaching numpy arrays as metadata to bounding boxes
